# Basiq Developer Documentation

> Guides, API reference documentation, and release history for the Basiq platform.

## Documentation indexes

- [Developer Hub](https://api.basiq.io/docs/llms.txt): Guides for integration, platform capabilities, data, and AI tools.
- [API Reference](https://api.basiq.io/reference/llms.txt): API concepts and endpoint documentation, including legacy APIs.
- [Changelog](https://api.basiq.io/changelog/llms.txt): Published product and API release history.
